findings.what: For the same single biochemistry mission (Organ Rescue Mission: 3 answers, 0 wrong, 1 hint), the Laboratories card says 'Clinical Biochemistry Lab ... 100% accuracy' while the Strengths and gaps card says 'Clinical biochemistry 3 steps 95%'. Likewise Hematology 92% accuracy vs competencies 100/100/89%. The code explains it (be/src/game.ts:683 competency score = max(0, 1 - 0.34*wrong - 0.15*hints), lab accuracy ignores hints), but nothing on screen says the competency percentage is hint-weighted, so two percentages for the same work look contradictory to a faculty reader. Not an overclaim, no raw error.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a one-line definition under the Strengths and gaps card ('competency score also lowers for hints') or mention in README; optional.
